bulk_readback.parser_note: R22 generalized the same pipeline to inline comma-separated Contrast authority and to explicit learner surfaces whose owners were accidentally omitted from historical owner metadata. No semantic judgment is performed by the parser.

review_model: dual-track: migration fidelity + latest semantic target under current LEARNING_CONTRACT; historical authority is evidence, not immutable truth

core.rule: all other historical R22 Core targets are defective or require a latest-target upgrade at current evidence

severe_examples.word:thrust: Current still keeps jet propulsion and geological intrusion as ordinary Active competitors instead of lower domain material around push/central point.
severe_examples.word:ticket: Political ticket and ticket-as-verb remain ordinary Active branches rather than lower/domain material around travel/admission and penalty notice.
severe_examples.word:tiger: The figurative fierce/aggressive person is still an ordinary Active sense rather than marked figurative/register material.
severe_examples.word:till: Current mashes cash till and glacial sediment into one Active sense instead of separating the common cash-till branch from specialist geology.
severe_examples.word:time: Current captures only a narrow subset of the required controlled high-frequency temporal model and leaves major recurrent structure to be repaired in Expansion.
severe_examples.word:to: Infinitival `to` is represented as an ordinary lexical preposition-like sense; function-word structure needs a cleaner model.
severe_examples.word:token: Current lacks the common digital authentication/access-token branch.
severe_examples.word:tolerate: Physiological tolerance is still split as a coequal dictionary sense instead of a domain extension of allowing/enduring.
severe_examples.word:tool: Current foregrounds pejorative person and rare verb material while missing explicit modern digital/software-tool learner access.
severe_examples.word:torch: Current lacks BrE torch = flashlight and keeps arson torch as an ordinary verb branch.
severe_examples.word:track: Current is incomplete as a path/record/course/follow model and does not yet own the full high-value tracking construction family.
severe_examples.word:transcend: Core wording is already good, but two overlapping Active exceed/surpass rows remain instead of one learner model.
severe_examples.word:transfer: Current remains split by realization/POS and does not yet own the useful noun/verb stress identity.
severe_examples.word:transit: Current lacks ordinary public-transit learner access while astrology-style transit remains Active.
severe_examples.word:translate: Current includes specialist geometric translation and passive ability material as coequal Active branches; the learner model needs controlled language/meaning/result structure.
severe_examples.word:transplant: Passive transplantability and generic person relocation remain ordinary Active competition around organ/plant/location transfer.
severe_examples.word:treasure: Only accumulated valuables survive Active; high-value cherish/value-as-verb access is missing.
severe_examples.word:trifle: The historical owner list omits this word, yet explicit authority approves BrE dessert `trifle`; Current lacks that common dessert branch and retains low-value verb material.
severe_examples.word:trip: Drug trip and generic exciting experience remain ordinary Active branches and need register/value control.
severe_examples.word:turkey: Proper `Turkey` country identity is flattened into an ordinary lowercase noun sense; case identity is not owned cleanly.
severe_examples.word:under: Rare defeat/downward/unconsciousness adverbial rows compete with the productive relation/function-word network.
severe_examples.word:unit: Multiple overlapping part/whole component rows remain separate instead of a compact learner model.
severe_examples.word:universe: Specialist domain-of-discourse material remains ordinary Active competition with the physical cosmos meaning.
severe_examples.word:up: Current is too narrow for the high-frequency particle/function network and still reflects POS-driven fragmentation.
severe_examples.word:use: Current noun/verb semantics are present but the high-value /juːs/ noun vs /juːz/ verb identity is not first-class.
severe_examples.word:vegetable: The dated/offensive incapacitated-person sense remains learner-active and needs removal or strong usage control.
severe_examples.word:velocity: Current definition says distance per unit time and therefore collapses velocity into speed, omitting direction.
severe_examples.word:ventilate: Core metadata says both ventilation and making-public while the active body owns only airflow; Current is internally inconsistent and too narrow.
severe_examples.word:vice: Current includes generic `vice = in place of` and lacks a clean BrE `vice` / AmE `vise` form identity.

fresh_semantic_judgments.latest: Current already owns the four productive zones—endpoint, advice, gratuity, tilt—without low-value specialist competition; missing tip off remains Expansion debt.
Current physical contact, emotional effect and small-amount model is sound; in/out of touch remains construction debt rather than a Core rewrite.
Current rotation/direction/change and turn/opportunity-development model is adequate; major turn phrasals remain separate Expansion debt.
Current single adjective model `in complete agreement` is already the desired learner Core.
Current one-model grasp-the-meaning representation already avoids the historical dictionary overlap; `understand that` is separate Expansion debt.
Current confirm/check truth-or-correctness model is already learner-usable; legal/domain verification need not inflate Core.
Current one-model `evil, cruel, or harmful` Core already consolidates the historical overlap; vicious cycle remains Expansion debt.
Model directional/recipient `to` separately from infinitival marker identity; do not represent infinitival `to` as an ordinary prepositional lexical sense.
Preserve symbol/substitute/computing-token branches and add common digital authentication/access-token use as a high-value modern branch.
Explicitly own BrE torch = AmE flashlight; literal flame torch remains valid, while arson-verb material is lower/register-marked.
Restore road/vehicle or people/goods movement and modern web/network traffic; illegal trade/traffic remains a marked separate branch.
Organize transfer around movement from one place/person/system to another and own noun/verb stress identity structurally rather than POS micro-senses.
Own passage/transport and public transit as productive learner uses; astrology/astronomy transit stays domain-lower.
Add BrE dessert `trifle` as a common separate noun branch; retain trivial amount/importance and marked verb material according to learner value.
Separate lowercase turkey bird/figurative failure from proper Turkey country identity; do not flatten case-sensitive entity identity into one ordinary noun sense.
Preserve noun and verb meanings but make the /juːs/ noun vs /juːz/ verb pronunciation identity first-class; keep used to/be used to/get used to structurally distinct from lexical use.
Keep food/plant uses; dated/offensive person-as-vegetable labeling must not remain ordinary learner Active and should be marked or removed from the main learner path.
Define velocity as rate of change of position with direction (vector quantity) and explicitly distinguish it from scalar speed.
Keep moral vice; own BrE tool `vice` versus AmE `vise` as a form identity and treat vice- = deputy as a combining form, not generic preposition `vice`.
